sources.snippet: 9. Groq/Cerebras 描述过宽：Groq=专用推理硬件+服务栈, 不是通用 CUDA/ROCm 替代; GroqCloud 目录仅列指定模型(Llama 3.1 8B/3.3 70B, GPT-OSS 20B/120B, Qwen 3.8 27B, Whisper 等)有模型级 token/s/价格/上下文/限额; 自定义权重/任意 HF 架构/特殊量化/多模态/自掌控数据面 ≠ 默认。Cerebras CS-4/WSE-3 Turbo 机柜级晶圆级专用; 托管模型 GPT-OSS 120B/Qwen 3.8 27B; 不能把"可部署硬件"/API/专用 endpoint 同一采购对象。

sources.title: An Empirical Study of Qwen3 Quantization - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Our findings reveal that while Qwen3 maintains competitive performance at moderate bit-widths, it experiences notable degradation in linguistic tasks under ultra-low precision, underscoring the persistent hurdles in LLM compression. These results emphasize the need for further research to mitigate performance loss in extreme quantization scenarios.
